messages:

Subject: New supplier onboarding + one-time payment request

Hi Karthik / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intake on this. LumenEdge Supply Co. is ready to be added to Redwood's vendor roster to receive a one-time sample shipment payment. Summary below — full attachments included.

- Legal name: LumenEdge Supply Co. (LLC)
- Legal entity type: US Limited Liability Company
- Tax ID (EIN): 12-3456789
- Primary remit address: 412 Harborview Dr, Suite 200, Portland, OR 97201
- Invoice email: accounts-payable@lumenedge.co
- AP contact: Ava Delgado, Senior Finance Ops (ava.delgado@lumenedge.co, +1 503-555-0192)
- Requested one-time payment: USD 2,400.00 (sample hardware order)
- Preferred payment method: ACH (attached ACH form)

Attachments: MasterProfile_Form.pdf (filled), W9_LumenEdge_2025.pdf, Bank_ACH_Form.xlsx

Can you confirm the PO number we should reference and any additional fields Finance needs on the vendor record to avoid payment delays? We can also sign any forms or e-sign if that helps.

Thanks —
Ava Delgado

ava.delgado@lumenedge.co | +1 503-555-0192


From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2025 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding + one-time payment request

Hi Ava — thanks, received. A couple quick asks before we can create a vendor master: 

1) Can you confirm company legal mailing address for tax correspondence (if different from remit).
2) Please confirm the W-9 shows the current EIN (we received W9 but need a signed/dated copy) — if already signed, great.
3) For ACH we need: bank account holder name, routing number (last 4 digits okay for initial intake), and a voided check or bank letter.

Next steps on our side: I’ll loop Marissa (AP onboarding) to intake the documents and create a provisional vendor record. If everything checks out we can issue a PO and route payment. If you need the payment faster, note our standard one-time payment path is Net 15 after PO and vendor record approval.

Please upload the voided check or the DocuSign ACH authorization link you prefer — we can accept DocuSign or scan. I’ve attached our Redwood Master Profile (link below) in case you want to confirm fields.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_master_profile

Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com


From: Ava Delgado <ava.delgado@lumenedge.co>

Date: Tue, 16 Dec 2025 08:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding + one-time payment request

Hi Karthik / Marissa — thanks for the checklist. I attached the signed W-9 and a completed ACH authorization (Bank_ACH_Form.xlsx). For security, full routing/account numbers are in the ACH file only. I pasted the last 4 digits below for reference.

- Bank: Cascade Commerce Bank
- Account holder: LumenEdge Supply Co.
- Routing (last 4): 6789
- Account (last 4): 4321

I also uploaded a scanned voided check to the DocuSign envelope so you should be able to verify. If you need the full bank letter we can provide it under an NDA — let me know.

Attached: W9_LumenEdge_2025.pdf (signed), Bank_ACH_Form.xlsx
DocuSign: https://na1.docusign.net/envelope/ABC123xyz

We're aiming for PO reference on the packing slip so our warehouse can reconcile. If a PO isn't available before shipment, please advise the reference we should use.

Best,
Ava


From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Delgado <ava.delgado@lumenedge.co>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Dec 2025 14:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: New supplier onboarding + one-time payment request

Hi Ava — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. 

We completed the provisional vendor record in our system (Vendor ID: RV-2025-1117-LUX) using the documents you attached. Next actions and timeline: 

- PO created: PO-4721 (one-time sample order) — please reference PO-4721 on the packing slip and invoice.
- Payment terms for this one-time: Net 15 from invoice date; payment scheduled to be issued to the ACH details provided once payment run completes.
- Outstanding item: we need a dated voided check or bank letter to finalize bank verification. The DocuSign envelope shows the file but Finance requires a dated voided check for ACH certification. If you can upload that to the Drive link or confirm we'll receive it by EOD Thursday (18 Dec) we can proceed without delay.

Attachments to Redwood record: MasterProfile_Form.pdf, W9_LumenEdge_2025.pdf, Bank_ACH_Form.xlsx

I'll notify once payment is booked. If anything changes on the shipping timeline, please let us know and include the freight carrier/tracking on the invoice.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Accounts Payable Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0147
